resources.string: Big dot clock, works on AOD. Long press: date.
Battery ring, animated while charging. Long press: percent.
Press the Glyph Button or shake the phone to roll.
Loops a design from Create. Long press: pause. Double press: restart.
Bars, a ring pulse or a radial spectrum from what\'s playing. Long press: next look.
Show glyphs, play compositions, start the visualiser and switch rules in DotForge. DotForge obeys only apps you allow.
Your favourite designs in turn; one a minute on the always-on display. Press: next. Long press: pause.
One always-on toy with the face you pick: clock and battery, gallery, moon or now playing. Long press: next face.
Play or pause and the track position. Press: play or pause. Long press: next track. Double press: previous.
Stopwatch or countdown. Press: start or pause. Long press: reset.
A compass needle. Long press: spirit level.
Snake. Press: turn right. Long press: turn left.
Box breathing: press to start four slow breaths.
Today\'s moon phase. Long press: days to the full moon.
Download speed now, on the ring and in numbers.
A design or the live Glyph on your home screen. Tap to show it on the Glyph.
